description: Why an element looks the way it does: for each CSS property the winning declaration — selector, stylesheet, rule position, !important, @layer, @media — and the ones it overrides, like the Styles panel of DevTools; query_dom gives the computed value, this gives who set it. Read-only, from the CSSOM: stylesheets of another origin without CORS are opaque and listed by href; user-agent styles, @container and @scope rules are not evaluated. properties narrows the output.

frame_id.description: Target iframe id from get_frames; omitted = main frame

include_inherited.description: Also inherited properties (color, font-*, custom properties) with the ancestor that sets them

properties.description: Only these, e.g. ["margin-top","--brand"]; margin covers its longhands. Omitted = every property a matching rule sets

selector.description: CSS selector; ">>>" pierces shadow DOM. Only the first match is inspected

tab_id.description: Target tab; omitted = last tab navigated in this session, else the active one

name: get_css_styles
